data.gender_notes: Jaydev is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jaydev is a Sanskrit name, derived from Jaya (victory) and Deva (god). This name signifies a victorious god or a god who brings victory. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is often referred to as Jaydev, as he was known to bring victory and success to his devotees. The name Jaydev carries the meaning “Victorious God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jaydev usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the victory of the soul over the body and material desires
data.etymology: Jaydev belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaydev total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jaydev has a rich cultural significance in Hindu tradition. It is a powerful name that evokes feelings of strength, courage, and prosperity. People with this name are often admired and respected for their determination and their ability to overcome challenges. Additionally, Jaydev is a popular and prestigious name in Indian literature. The most prominent figure with this name is Jayadeva, a 12th-century poet and the author of the Sanskrit epic text "Gita Govinda." This work is renowned for its deep exploration of the love and devotion of Lord Krishna and Radha.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the name Jaydev is considered an auspicious and blessed name, signifying protection, blessings, and ultimate victory over life's challenges. It symbolizes a connection to the divine and the presence of god in one's life. People who carry this name are believed to be fortunate, and they are encouraged to seek the blessings of the various deities associated with the name for guidance, strength, and success.versely, it is also believed that the name Jayadev can disorder the mind, causing restlessness and agitation, so it must be used with caution and reverence. Overall, the name Jaydev represents victory, divinity, and spiritual growth, inspiring its bearers to embody these qualities in their everyday lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jaydev: Victorious in devotion. One who has conquered the senses and is devoted to God.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Jaydev continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
